where: first line: 'on va montrer 6.10 d'abord pour X_o et N'_o = N_o + d'
scan: N'_o = N_o + d, the prime on the left-hand N (both scans; crops_356_360/m356_N.png, w356_top.png)
note: R_0 is generated by N'_0 with gamma^k(N'_0) = 0 for k > d; the element that meets the hypothesis of 6.10 (lambda^k = 0 for k > d) is N_0 = N'_0 + d, and the proof uses exactly that: lambda_{-1}(N_0) = (-1)^d gamma^d(N'_0) (same page), and R_0 -> R sends N'_0 to N - d and N_0 to N. The printed equation is reversed (with it N'_0 would go to N + d). The TeX keeps the printed reading; the corrected layer too.
